changes.motivation: Brand.nominal provides no runtime validation — invalid branch names only fail at git execution time with cryptic errors. Refined brands validate at construction time, giving users clear errors immediately.
changes.summary: Converted BranchName from Brand.nominal to Brand.refined in src/services/Git/types.ts with an isValidBranchName predicate implementing all 11 git check-ref-format rules. Also converted ProjectId from Brand.nominal to Brand.refined with UUID regex validation. Both predicates are exported for testing.

changes.motivation: Brand.refined constructors throw on invalid input. Inside Effect.gen, uncaught throws become opaque defects rather than typed errors the CLI can format nicely.
changes.summary: Updated src/cli/parser.ts to defer brand validation for all flag and positional arg sites, then validate all at once using Effect.partition. Single failure yields InvalidValue; multiple failures yield a new ValidationErrors tagged error (added to errors.ts) containing all InvalidValue instances. Added extractBrandError helper to format brand error messages.

changes.motivation: config.primary_branch is external data and could contain an invalid branch name, which would throw a defect instead of producing a user-visible error.
changes.summary: Wrapped BranchName(config.primary_branch) in Effect.try in src/commands/mux/merge/handler.ts so an invalid project config value produces a clear error.

changes.motivation: Provide test coverage for the new refined brand predicates and parser brand-rejection paths.
changes.summary: Added 3 invalid-brand rejection tests to src/cli/parser.test.ts. Created src/services/Git/types.test.ts with 40 tests covering valid and invalid branch names (all 11 rules) and valid/invalid UUIDs.

changes.motivation: Needed a way to test passing invalid CLI arguments to exercise the refined brand validation end-to-end without using real commands.
changes.summary: Created src/commands/dev/echo/command.ts — a dev subcommand accepting an optional BranchName positional arg and an optional --project-id / -p ProjectId flag that echoes the parsed values back. Registered it in src/commands/dev/index.ts.

changes.motivation: Error output was showing structured log prefixes (timestamp, level, fiber) because CliLoggerLive was provided before catchAll, so parse errors fell through to the default Effect logger.
changes.summary: Moved Effect.provide(CliLoggerLive) to wrap the entire pipeline after catchAll in src/main.ts so the custom logger (no timestamps, stderr) applies to all error output. Also added ValidationErrors handling in the error formatter.

changes.motivation: Brand.error messages like 'Invalid project ID (expected UUID): not-u' combined with the InvalidValue formatter produced a redundant, double-repeating error message.
changes.summary: Changed Brand.error messages in types.ts to describe expectations concisely ('a valid git branch name', 'a valid UUID') so the full error reads cleanly: "Invalid value 'not-u' for --project-id. Expected: a valid UUID".

changes.motivation: The sync command was deleted but its import remained in mux/index.ts, causing a runtime crash when running any CLI command.
changes.summary: Removed the broken import of the deleted sync command from src/commands/mux/index.ts.

problems: The deleted `mux sync` command left a dangling import in src/commands/mux/index.ts that wasn't caught until the CLI was run interactively — no build or type error surfaces a missing local file import in this setup, so deletions should include removing their import sites.

Brand.error message format was not documented: the raw message is concatenated directly after 'Expected:' in the InvalidValue formatter, so messages that repeat context already in the formatter (like 'Invalid X: value') produce redundant output. The contract between Brand.error strings and the error formatter should be explicit.

CliLoggerLive placement in main.ts was counterintuitive: providing the custom logger before catchAll meant error paths silently fell back to the default structured logger, emitting timestamp/level/fiber prefixes on user-visible errors. The correct ordering (provide logger after catchAll) was not obvious from reading main.ts.
